import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
print("Unique Category values:", df['Category'].unique())
print("Unique Program values:", df['Program'].unique())
# Check rows where Category == 'Admin' or Program contains Admin
admin_category_sum = df[df['Category'].str.lower()=='admin']['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Sum where Category == 'Admin':", admin_category_sum)
# Also maybe Category is 'Admin' but could be 'Admin' vs 'Program' etc.
# Let's also check Program == 'Admin (organisation-wide)'
admin_program_sum = df[df['Program']=='Admin (organisation-wide)']['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Sum where Program == 'Admin (organisation-wide)':", admin_program_sum)
# Also check both?
both = df[(df['Category'].str.lower()=='admin') | (df['Program']=='Admin (organisation-wide)')]['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Combined sum:", both)
# Show some rows
print(df[df['Category'].str.lower()=='admin'].head())
print(df[df['Program']=='Admin (organisation-wide)'].head())

print("Count:", len(admin_rows))
print("Sum:", admin_rows['Amount (INR)'].sum())
# Show distribution
print(admin_rows.groupby('Program')['Amount (INR)'].sum())
